elements.name: Fire
elements.lore: A furnace-keep of slag and iron. Thick walls, single-minded fire.

elements.name: Water
elements.lore: A drowned tower humming with current. A fast economy behind thinner walls.

elements.name: Earth
elements.lore: A mountain hollowed into a fortress. Roots in bedrock, walls that have never fallen.

elements.name: Wind
elements.lore: A wind-scoured crag of open sky and screaming updrafts. Nothing lingers; everything strikes and is gone.

elements.name: Forest
elements.lore: A living rampart of root and bough. Slow to rouse, impossible to clear.

elements.name: Electric
elements.lore: A crackling pylon-hold. Everything here moves first and hits like a storm.

elements.name: Light
elements.lore: A gold-vaulted cloister where dawnlight never fails. Patient walls, unyielding grace.

elements.name: Dark
elements.lore: A sunken crypt of whispering dark. Everything here is sharpened, spent, and fed to the void.

elements.name: Divine
elements.lore: A vaulted sanctum of judgement-light, beyond the reach of any single banner.

keywords.inspectText: Detonate 0. When destroyed, deals 0 to the deadliest enemy creature (or an enemy structure). Never hits a command center.
Undertow. When this blocks or is attacked, the strongest attacking creature is hurled back to its owner's hand (re-summoning-sick).
Entrench. Immovable — cannot be bounced or pushed; effects like Undertow slide off.
Ward. On entry, conjures a 0/2 Lumen token blocker beside it.
Reap 0. When destroyed, raises a 0/0 Shade token in its place.
Chrysalis 0/3. Cannot attack; swells +1 each of your turns, then hatches into undefined (⚔undefined/♥undefined).
Scour. Flier — ignores interceptors and shatters an enemy back-row card on attack.
Overcharge. Banks ◆ each of your turns (up to 3); when it attacks it discharges them as bonus ⚔.

commanders.name: Fire / Water
commanders.desc: A steam-forge keep, hissing between anvil and cistern. It boils its own moat to fight.

commanders.name: Fire / Earth
commanders.desc: A kiln-foundry of baked clay walls. Fire sets what the earth has shaped.

commanders.name: Fire / Wind
commanders.desc: A bellows-citadel where wind feeds the furnace. It breathes, and the fire screams.

commanders.name: Fire / Forest
commanders.desc: A char-grove smoldering behind green walls. It burns the forest to fertilize the next.

commanders.name: Fire / Electric
commanders.desc: A plasma-spire crowned in welding light. Heat and current fused past parting.

commanders.name: Fire / Light
commanders.desc: A solar-furnace of mirrored fire. It does not warm; it consumes by daylight.

commanders.name: Fire / Dark
commanders.desc: An ember-vault banked in cold ash. Its fire burns blackest where no light reaches.

commanders.name: Water / Earth
commanders.desc: A delta-hold of silt and slow water. It builds new ground from what the river drowns.

commanders.name: Water / Wind
commanders.desc: A mist-cistern wreathed in cold fog. It hides its walls behind its own breath.

commanders.name: Water / Forest
commanders.desc: A mangrove-keep half-swallowed by tide. Root and water hold the same line.

commanders.name: Water / Electric
commanders.desc: A storm-cistern wired to the rain. Every drop it catches it returns as a spark.

commanders.name: Water / Light
commanders.desc: A glacier-hall of refracting ice. It bends the dawn and keeps the cold.

commanders.name: Water / Dark
commanders.desc: A drowned-vault below the black tide. What sinks there is never given back.

commanders.name: Earth / Wind
commanders.desc: A canyon-bastion carved by the gale. The wind shapes the stone and the stone shapes the wind.

commanders.name: Earth / Forest
commanders.desc: A terraced grove of stone and root. The mountain wears the forest like a cloak.

commanders.name: Earth / Electric
commanders.desc: A geode-tower veined with raw current. It stores the storm in solid rock.

commanders.name: Earth / Light
commanders.desc: A marble-fastness facing the sun. Mountain bones lit white to their core.

commanders.name: Earth / Dark
commanders.desc: A barrow-keep dug into lightless rock. The deep stone keeps its dead unburied.

commanders.name: Wind / Forest
commanders.desc: A storm-canopy of singing leaves. The gale combs the branches and the branches answer in sparks.

commanders.name: Wind / Electric
commanders.desc: A galleon-spire riding the lightning front. It sails on its own thunder.

commanders.name: Wind / Light
commanders.desc: A lantern-spire of open air and light. Nothing it holds is ever in shadow.

commanders.name: Wind / Dark
commanders.desc: A gale-vault of howling dark corridors. The wind carries off what the dark takes.

commanders.name: Forest / Electric
commanders.desc: A storm-canopy bristling with charged thorns. The forest fruits in lightning.

commanders.name: Forest / Light
commanders.desc: A bloom-bastion of luminous boughs. It grows toward the light and feeds on it.

commanders.name: Forest / Dark
commanders.desc: A thornwood-vault tangled in night. Its roots drink the dark and the dark drinks back.

commanders.name: Electric / Light
commanders.desc: A beacon-coil ringed in radiant current. It burns and shines as one act.

commanders.name: Electric / Dark
commanders.desc: A blackout-tower of caged storms. Its lightning never escapes its own walls.

commanders.name: Light / Dark
commanders.desc: A dusk-bastion balanced on the line of day. It gives light with one hand and takes it with the other.

structures.desc: Town hall of the host. Yields ◆1 a turn and raises ⚒+2. Unlocks the forges and the Longhouse. Upgrades (in the back row) to a Keep.
A staging camp — raises ⚒+2. Upgrade it (in the front row) into a Longhouse.
Hearth and full benches — quarters ⚒+3 of workforce. Your main workforce. Upgrades (in the front row) to a Barracks.
Cisterns that hold the surplus — unspent mana drains at end of turn, but a vault keeps up to ◆4 of it. Upgrades to a Grand Vault. ⚒0.
A heavy wall of stone — a huge body that soaks raids aimed at your line, and raises ⚒+1.
A forward post — raises ⚒+1. Branches on upgrade into a Cannon Tower (offense) or a Bastion (defense).
Guns that never sleep — strikes the nearest enemy creature for 1000 each turn. Needs ⚒2 to crew (build it where a row has the workers to spare).
Sanctified vault — once per turn at upkeep, returns your most recently fallen creature to your hand. ⚒+1.
The Foundry grown into a Keep — ◆1 a turn, ⚒+3, far sturdier walls. Upgrades to a Citadel.
The seat of your realm — ◆2 a turn, ⚒+4, and a mighty rampart of stone.
Drill yards and armories — quarters ⚒+4 of workforce.
A fortified bastion — the sturdiest body on the board, and raises ⚒+2.
Deep cisterns behind bank-vault doors — keeps up to ◆10 of your unspent mana across the turn. ⚒0.
